default/30650.htm.text: Priest of the Earth Gerald: May the abundance of Maphr be with you! If you would like to receive the graces of abundance, make your donations! It shall be returned to you tenfold, hundredfold!

Q00010_IntoTheWorld/30650-01.html.text: Priest of the Earth Gerald: Why? Are you here to make a contribution to Maphr?

links.text: "Here's the gift. Who has the right to strip mine?"

Q00010_IntoTheWorld/30650-04.html.text: Priest of the Earth Gerald: You again, huh?! Although I'll consider the right to strip mine more in the future, tell whoever sent this gift that he has a slight chance to strip mine the Mithril this time. Bring me more gifts when you can.

Q00215_TrialOfThePilgrim/30650-01.html.text: Priest of the Earth Gerald: You have come to the right place! Maphr is my specialty! 6 years in the seminary, and 10 years of self-guided research after that... I feel that I have learned practically all there is to know about Maphr. I could use additional funds to further my research... Would you …

Q00215_TrialOfThePilgrim/30650-04.html.text: Priest of the Earth Gerald: Oh my, I didn't notice your badge! I, I just... That is... Eh, just a joke... I, I mean, I was going to keep it safe for you and return it with interest. Well I must be going!

Q00010_IntoTheWorld/30650-02.html.text: Priest of the Earth Gerald: Very nice! Maphr should be pleased. It's not from you, eh? I think I know who would send me this kind of gift and ask you to find out such a thing. Well, thanks for the gift, but I can't tell you who has the right to strip mine. However, I will give you a hint for the pe…

Q00010_IntoTheWorld/30650-03.html.text: Priest of the Earth Gerald: Where's the gift? I don't see one. Do you dare to trifle with a priest of the earth? What kind of person would ask about the right to strip mine without giving a gift to Maphr?

Q00215_TrialOfThePilgrim/30650-02.html.text: Priest of the Earth Gerald: What a generous donation! Maphr will surely be pleased, and the world will be a better place thanks to you. What a wonderful investment, er, I mean, offering! Here is a book I wrote regarding the will of Maphr. Study it diligently! May the grace of Maphr be with you!

Q00215_TrialOfThePilgrim/30650-03.html.text: Priest of the Earth Gerald: I suppose I was wrong about you... I had no idea you were a beggar... Now, on your way! Shoo!
